scanNote:
11-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (80-bet) - 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI AMALIYoTI.

Yuqorida chapda QIZIL yorliqda oq '11' va 'Our Precious Planet'.

CHAP USTUN:
17) 'Read the questions and choose the answer you agree most with. Are your answers mostly a, b or c? See the key to find out how green you are.'
   YaShIL-SARIQ QUTI, ko'k-yashil sarlavha 'How Green Are You?':
   1 If you had a lot of old newspapers and empty bottles, would you ... a leave them on the pavement? b put them in a rubbish bin? c recycle them?
   2 If somebody offered to give you one of the following as a gift, which would you choose? a a big, fast car b a motorbike c a bicycle
   3 If you were in the middle of a city and wanted to go somewhere one or two kilometres away, would you ... a take a taxi? b take a bus? c walk/cycle?
   4 If you had a picnic on the beach, what would you do with your rubbish? Would you ... a leave your rubbish on the beach? b put your rubbish in the first bin you found? c take your rubbish home?
   5 If you had £1,000 to spend, would you ... a buy a fur coat? b go on a safari? c adopt a dolphin?
   OQ QOG'OZ (kalit): mostly a's: 'You're not very green, are you? Please look after our world before it's too late!' mostly b's: 'You're trying to be more green, but you don't always get it right. Learn more about the environment and think before you act.' mostly c's: 'Well done! You're really green! We need more people like you to help us save our environment!'

O'NG USTUN:
18) 'Look at the pictures, then use the words in the list below to ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Qiya ro'yxat: 'play, use, buy, get, go, spend, travel, visit'. SURATLAR: 1 ayol kompyuter oldida '... a computer'; 2 qizil kichik samolyot '... an aeroplane'; 3 dollar dastalari '... lots of money'. Ko'k qiya: 'SA: What would you do if you had a computer? SB: If I had a computer, I would play computer games and I would use the Internet. What about you? SA: If I had a computer, ...'
19) 'GAME: Look at this sequence of sentences, then use the prompts below to act out similar hypotheses.' Ko'k qiya: S1: 'IF I WERE VERY RICH, I would go on holiday.' S2: 'If I went on holiday, I'd go to London.' S3: 'If I went to London, I'd visit Buckingham Palace.' S4: 'If I visited Buckingham Palace, I would meet the Queen.' S5: 'If I met the Queen ...' Nuqtalar: • If I won £1,000,000 ... • If I met my favourite film star ... • If I got lost in the mountains ...
20) 'In pairs, use the prompts below to ask and answer questions, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: 'SA: What would you do if you found a spider in your bed? SB: If I found a spider in my bed, I'd scream.' 1 find a spider in your bed 2 see a UFO 3 be able to travel back in time 4 accidentally bump somebody's car while parking 5 lose your best friend's favourite jacket 6 be shipwrecked on a desert island

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '80'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the questions and choose the answer you agree most with. Are your answers mostly a, b or c? See the key to find out how green you are.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni o'qing va eng ko'p rozi bo'lgan javobingizni tanlang. Javoblaringiz asosan a, b yoki c mi? Qanchalik 'yashil' ekaningizni bilish uchun kalitga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'GREEN' bu yerda = tabiatni
sevuvchi, ekologik ongli.


SO'ROVNOMA (o'zingiz haqingizda -
to'g'ri javob yo'q):

  1 eski gazeta va butilkalar:
    a yo'lakda qoldirish
    b axlat qutisiga
    c qayta ishlash
  2 sovg'a: a katta tez mashina
    b mototsikl  c velosiped
  3 shahar markazida 1-2 km:
    a taksi  b avtobus  c piyoda/
    velosiped
  4 plyajda piknik axlati:
    a plyajda qoldirish  b birinchi
    qutiga  c uyga olib ketish
  5 £1,000: a mo'yna palto  b safari
    c delfinni 'asrab olish'


KALIT:
  ko'proq a → 'yashil' emassiz!
  ko'proq b → harakat qilyapsiz,
    lekin har doim to'g'ri emas
  ko'proq c → Barakalla! Chindan
    'yashil'siz!


⚠ 'A PAVEMENT':

  = yo'lak (piyodalar yo'li).
  ⚠ AmE 'sidewalk'.


⚠ 'TO OFFER':

  = taklif qilmoq (bermoq).
  ⚠ 'offered to give' = berishni
  taklif qildi.


⚠ 'A GIFT' = 'A PRESENT':

  = sovg'a.


⚠ 'A FUR COAT':

  = mo'yna palto.
  ⚠ 'fur' = mo'yna.


⚠ 'TO ADOPT':

  = asrab olmoq.
  ⚠ 'adopt a dolphin' = delfinni
  himoya qilish uchun pul berish.


⚠ 'TO LOOK AFTER':

  = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, qaramoq.


⚠ 'BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE':

  = juda kech bo'lishidan oldin.


⚠ 'TO GET IT RIGHT':

  = to'g'ri qilmoq.


⚠ 'THINK BEFORE YOU ACT':

  = harakat qilishdan oldin o'yla.
  ⚠ 'to act' = harakat qilmoq.


⚠ 'YOU'RE NOT VERY GREEN, ARE YOU?':

  = savol-quyruq (tag question).
  Inkor gap → ijobiy quyruq.

points.en: 1 If you had a lot of old newspapers and empty bottles, would you ... a) leave them on the pavement? b) put them in a rubbish bin? c) recycle them?
points.uz: 1 Agar sizda ko'p eski gazeta va bo'sh butilkalar bo'lsa, ... a) ularni yo'lakda qoldirarmidingiz? b) axlat qutisiga solarmidingiz? c) qayta ishlarmidingiz?

points.en: 2 If somebody offered to give you one of the following as a gift, which would you choose? a) a big, fast car b) a motorbike c) a bicycle
points.uz: 2 Agar kimdir sizga quyidagilardan birini sovg'a qilishni taklif qilsa, qaysisini tanlardingiz? a) katta, tez mashina b) mototsikl c) velosiped

points.en: 3 If you were in the middle of a city and wanted to go somewhere one or two kilometres away, would you ... a) take a taxi? b) take a bus? c) walk/cycle?
points.uz: 3 Agar shahar markazida bo'lsangiz va 1-2 km uzoqlikdagi joyga bormoqchi bo'lsangiz, ... a) taksi olarmidingiz? b) avtobusga o'tirarmidingiz? c) piyoda/velosipedda borarmidingiz?

points.en: 4 If you had a picnic on the beach, what would you do with your rubbish? Would you ... a) leave your rubbish on the beach? b) put your rubbish in the first bin you found? c) take your rubbish home?
points.uz: 4 Agar plyajda piknik qilsangiz, axlatingizni nima qilardingiz? ... a) plyajda qoldirarmidingiz? b) topgan birinchi qutingizga solarmidingiz? c) uyga olib ketarmidingiz?
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'the first bin you found' - topgan birinchi quti.

points.en: 5 If you had £1,000 to spend, would you ... a) buy a fur coat? b) go on a safari? c) adopt a dolphin?
points.uz: 5 Agar sarflash uchun 1000 funtingiz bo'lsa, ... a) mo'yna palto sotib olarmidingiz? b) safariga borarmidingiz? c) delfinni asrab olarmidingiz?

points.en: Mostly a's: You're not very green, are you? Please look after our world before it's too late!
points.uz: Ko'proq a: Siz unchalik 'yashil' emassiz, shundaymi? Iltimos, juda kech bo'lishidan oldin dunyomizga g'amxo'rlik qiling!

points.en: Mostly b's: You're trying to be more green, but you don't always get it right. Learn more about the environment and think before you act.
points.uz: Ko'proq b: Siz ko'proq 'yashil' bo'lishga harakat qilyapsiz, lekin har doim ham to'g'ri qilmaysiz. Atrof-muhit haqida ko'proq o'rganing va harakat qilishdan oldin o'ylang.

points.en: Mostly c's: Well done! You're really green! We need more people like you to help us save our environment!
points.uz: Ko'proq c: Barakalla! Siz chindan 'yashil'siz! Atrof-muhitimizni saqlashga yordam berish uchun bizga siz kabi ko'proq odamlar kerak!

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then use the words in the list below to ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example. play, use, buy, get, go, spend, travel, visit
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang, keyin quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib juftlikda savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. play, use, buy, get, go, spend, travel, visit
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What would you do if you had
      a computer?
  SB: If I had a computer, I would
      play computer games and I
      would use the Internet. What
      about you?
  SA: If I had a computer, ...


SURATLAR:
  1 a computer (kompyuter)
  2 an aeroplane (samolyot)
  3 lots of money (ko'p pul)


⚠ SAVOL QOLIPI:
  'What WOULD you do if you HAD
   ...?'
  ⚠ Savolda 'would' oldinga chiqadi.


⚠ 'AN AEROPLANE':

  = samolyot.
  ⚠ AmE 'airplane'; qisqasi 'plane'.


⚠ 'LOTS OF' = 'A LOT OF':

  = ko'p.

items.question: What would you do if you had a computer?
items.answer: If I had a computer, I would play computer games and I would use the Internet.

items.question: What would you do if you had an aeroplane?
items.answer: If I had an aeroplane, I would travel around the world and I would visit lots of countries.

items.question: What would you do if you had lots of money?
items.answer: If I had lots of money, I would buy a big house and I would go on holiday.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: Look at this sequence of sentences, then use the prompts below to act out similar hypotheses. • If I won £1,000,000 ... • If I met my favourite film star ... • If I got lost in the mountains ...
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Bu gaplar zanjiriga qarang, keyin quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash farazlarni o'ynang. • Agar 1,000,000 funt yutsam ... • Agar sevimli kino yulduzimni uchratsam ... • Agar tog'da adashib qolsam ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI ZANJIR:
  S1: If I were very rich, I would
      go on holiday.
  S2: If I went on holiday, I'd go
      to London.
  S3: If I went to London, I'd visit
      Buckingham Palace.
  S4: If I visited Buckingham Palace,
      I would meet the Queen.
  S5: If I met the Queen ...

  ⚠ QOIDA: oldingi gapning NATIJASI
  keyingi gapning ShARTI bo'ladi.
  'would go' → 'If I went'


⚠ 'A SEQUENCE':

  = ketma-ketlik, zanjir.


⚠ 'A HYPOTHESIS':

  = faraz. Ko'plik: 'hypotheses'.


⚠ 'TO ACT OUT':

  = sahnalashtirmoq, o'ynab
  ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'TO WIN':

  won - won. = yutmoq.


⚠ 'TO GET LOST':

  = adashib qolmoq.


⚠ 'BUCKINGHAM PALACE':

  = Bukingem saroyi (London,
  qirolicha qarorgohi).
exercises.exampleEn: If I were very rich, I would go on holiday. If I went on holiday, I'd go to London. If I went to London, I'd visit Buckingham Palace. If I visited Buckingham Palace, I would meet the Queen.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar juda boy bo'lsam, ta'tilga borardim. Agar ta'tilga borsam, Londonga borardim. Agar Londonga borsam, Bukingem saroyiga borardim. Agar Bukingem saroyiga borsam, Qirolichani uchratardim.
modelAnswers: If I won £1,000,000, I would buy a boat. If I bought a boat, I'd sail around the world. If I sailed around the world, I'd visit Australia.
If I met my favourite film star, I would ask for a photo. If I asked for a photo, we would become friends. If we became friends, I would visit Hollywood.
If I got lost in the mountains, I would look for a village. If I found a village, I'd ask for help. If I asked for help, someone would take me home.
modelAnswersUz: Agar 1,000,000 funt yutsam, qayiq sotib olardim. Agar qayiq sotib olsam, dunyo bo'ylab suzardim. Agar dunyo bo'ylab suzsam, Avstraliyaga borardim.
Agar sevimli kino yulduzimni uchratsam, surat so'rardim. Agar surat so'rasam, do'st bo'lardik. Agar do'st bo'lsak, Gollivudga borardim.
Agar tog'da adashib qolsam, qishloq qidirardim. Agar qishloq topsam, yordam so'rardim. Agar yordam so'rasam, kimdir meni uyga olib borardi.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts below to ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What would you do if you found
      a spider in your bed?
  SB: If I found a spider in my bed,
      I'd scream.

  ⚠ 'your' → 'my' ga o'zgaradi!


⚠ 'A SPIDER':

  = o'rgimchak.


⚠ 'TO SCREAM':

  = qichqirmoq.


⚠ 'A UFO':

  = NUJ (noma'lum uchuvchi jism).
  ⚠ 'A UFO' - 'an' EMAS, chunki
  /juː/ deb o'qiladi.


⚠ 'TO TRAVEL BACK IN TIME':

  = vaqtda orqaga sayohat qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'be able to' → 'if I WERE able
  to' yoki 'if I COULD'.


⚠ 'ACCIDENTALLY':

  = tasodifan.
  ⚠ 'accident' = baxtsiz hodisa.


⚠ 'TO BUMP':

  = urib olmoq (yengil).


⚠ 'WHILE PARKING':

  = mashina qo'yayotganda.
  ⚠ 'while + -ING'.


⚠ 'TO BE SHIPWRECKED':

  = kema halokatiga uchramoq.
  ⚠ 'a shipwreck' = kema halokati.


⚠ 'A DESERT ISLAND':

  = kimsasiz orol.
  ⚠ 'desert' /ˈdezət/ - bu yerda
  'cho'l' emas, 'bo'sh, kimsasiz'.

items.prompt: find a spider in your bed
items.question: What would you do if you found a spider in your bed?
items.answer: If I found a spider in my bed, I'd scream.

items.question: What would you do if you saw a UFO?
items.answer: If I saw a UFO, I'd take a photo of it.
items.whyUz: ⚠ see → SAW. Boshqa javob ham bo'lishi mumkin.

items.prompt: be able to travel back in time
items.question: What would you do if you were able to travel back in time?
items.answer: If I were able to travel back in time, I'd visit ancient Egypt.

items.prompt: accidentally bump somebody's car while parking
items.question: What would you do if you accidentally bumped somebody's car while parking?
items.answer: If I accidentally bumped somebody's car while parking, I'd leave a note with my phone number.

items.prompt: lose your best friend's favourite jacket
items.question: What would you do if you lost your best friend's favourite jacket?
items.answer: If I lost my best friend's favourite jacket, I'd buy him a new one.

items.prompt: be shipwrecked on a desert island
items.question: What would you do if you were shipwrecked on a desert island?
items.answer: If I were shipwrecked on a desert island, I'd build a boat.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 2-tur shart gaplari - savol va zanjir qoliplari.

patterns.formula: What would you do if you + PAST SIMPLE?
patterns.exampleEn: What would you do if you had a computer?

patterns.formula: If I + PAST SIMPLE, I'd + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If I found a spider in my bed, I'd scream.
If you had £1,000, would you buy a fur coat?
patterns.exampleUz: Agar 1000 funtingiz bo'lsa, mo'yna palto sotib olarmidingiz?
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'would you' - qisqa javob: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.

patterns.formula: ZANJIR: If A, I would B. If I B-ed, I'd C.
patterns.exampleEn: If I went to London, I'd visit Buckingham Palace. If I visited Buckingham Palace, I would meet the Queen.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar Londonga borsam, Bukingem saroyiga borardim. Agar Bukingem saroyiga borsam, Qirolichani uchratardim.
